title: UN chief says ‘subsidising fossil fuels is subsidising suicide’
description: The United Nations (UN) says that for every dollar invested in protecting or restoring nature, about US$30 still goes into activities that degrade it.

title: Canceled Assassin’s Creed Destiny Footage Shows Leap of Faith and Stealth Kills in Ancient China, Plus an Umbrella-Like Spinning Weapon
description: An unannounced (and now canceled) game titled Assassin's Creed Destiny leaked via MP1st, which provided details on its development and even some footage. According to the report, Destiny was a major project for PC and consoles set during China's Qin Dynasty in 206 BCE, a few years later than Assassin's Creed Jade, the mobile game that is reportedly still in development after several years of silence. Like Jade, it was in development at TiMi Studios; however, the Chinese developer was caught in a major restructuring in early 2025, and Assassin's Creed Destiny was canceled shortly afterward.
